items.title: Introducing Qwen-VL
items.summary: Along with the rapid development of our large language model Qwen, we leveraged Qwen’s capabilities and unified multimodal pretraining to address the limitations of multimodal models in generalization, and we opensourced multimodal model Qwen-VL in Sep. 2023. items.summaryZh: 基于统一的多模态预训练，通义千问对其Qwen-VL系列进行了重大升级，推出了Qwen-VL-Plus与Qwen-VL-Max两个增强版本。新版本大幅提升了图像相关的推理能力、图文细节提取与分析水平，并全面支持百万像素以上的高清图像及多种宽高比输入。
